title: Gig worker money tip: missed a quarterly tax payment?
label: Gig worker tip

lines: Priya skipped her September tax payment.
"I'll just pay it all in April."

beats.sub: Paying now stops it from growing.

items.s: IRS Direct Pay or your online account.

cta.sub: We'll DM you the quarterly tax calculator.

captions.instagram:
Missed a quarterly estimated tax payment? Waiting until April makes it worse.

✔️ The IRS underpayment penalty is figured on each late amount for the number of days it stays unpaid.
✔️ Pay the missed amount now through IRS Direct Pay or your IRS online account.
✔️ The last 2026 payment is due January 15, 2027.
✔️ The safe amount is generally 90% of your 2026 tax or 100% of your 2025 tax, whichever is less (110% if your 2025 AGI was over $150,000).

Our quarterly estimated tax calculator works out your federal and state payment.
